name: mozoleum
description: МОЗОЛЕУМ — satirical auction-house generator of honorary calluses

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mozoleum/engine && npm run build -w @mozoleum/server && npm run build -w @mozoleum/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mozoleum/engine && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
